answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax: a 60 POA fee, burned on arrival, before it can earn. Like saffron, pricey because each flower yields so little, each fake grows costly. Minting 100 fakes costs 6,000 POA and returns nothing, while an honest agent pays 60 once, then earns over a long horizon. That delta — one honest cost versus a hundred fake ones — is the defense: fakes burn money faster than they steal it, so honest rewards stay undiluted.
